description: This file is the main entry point for a Vue.js application, setting up the app instance, including plugins like Pinia for state management and Vue Router for routing, and mounting the application to a DOM element.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins (Pinia and router) with the Vue application instance.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue application to the DOM element with id 'app'.
